d: Short, midnight blue hair is styled in a ponytail with long, sweeping bangs framing a youthful, serene face with narrow, midnight blue eyes. A slender build is dressed in a salmon-pink kimono with a white collar, tied with a dark navy obi and paired with a long, dark navy hakama. The figure carries a traditional Japanese longbow and a quiver of arrows, accompanied by a large, stylized aircraft carrier deck resting vertically against the back.
